Definition: to stride (from spreading the legs), i.e. rush upon
BiblicalUsage: Pasa means to stride, to rush upon, to spread the legs in a rush. It appears once, in Isaiah 27:4, where the Lord says, who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God strides through briers and thorns the way a man strides through grass, and nothing set against Him can stand.
